title: Monorepo — installed operation invocation
body:
actor Caller
participant "POST /v1/op" as HTTP
participant "Substrate client" as Client
participant "InstalledOpInvoker" as Invoke
database "Installed PostgreSQL catalog" as Catalog
database "Selected PostgreSQL datasource" as DB
Caller -> HTTP : name / named args / row cap / timeout
alt missing name
 HTTP --> Caller : 400 invalid_request_error
else platform operation requires unavailable permission
 HTTP --> Caller : 403 platform_permission_required
else negative timeout
 HTTP --> Caller : 400 invalid_request_error
else request valid at HTTP boundary
 HTTP -> Client : InvokeOpAsync
 Client -> Client : IsWritable(name) selects writable or read-only datasource
 Client -> Invoke : InvokeAsync(selected datasource, arguments)
 Invoke -> Catalog : ApiCatalogAsync(name) through ops.api
 Catalog --> Invoke : installed matching signatures and kinds
 note over Catalog
 ops.api reads pg_proc / pg_namespace.
 SQL source declarations are not the installed catalog.
 end note
 alt no exact installed name
  Invoke --> Client : error + suggested names
 else zero matching overloads or ambiguity
  Invoke --> Client : error + signatures
 else unnamed parameters with named arguments
  Invoke --> Client : error
 else exactly one usable overload
  Invoke -> Invoke : quote catalog identifiers / bind named values
  alt procedure
   Invoke -> DB : CALL with declared casts + timeout + cancellation
   DB --> Invoke : completion or exception
   Invoke --> Client : called / kind / progress-log locator
  else non-procedure kind
   Invoke -> DB : SELECT with LIMIT rowCap + 1
   DB --> Invoke : rows
   Invoke -> Invoke : normalize values / retain cap / mark truncation
   Invoke --> Client : rows + truncated_at
  end
 end
 alt PostgreSQL error outside SQLSTATE classes 08 / 53 / 57 / 58
  Client --> HTTP : OpResult.Error with SQLSTATE and message
 else availability SQLSTATE / NpgsqlException / TimeoutException
  Client --> HTTP : SubstrateUnavailableException
 else result
  Client --> HTTP : OpResult
 end
 alt result.Error
  HTTP --> Caller : 400 invalid_request_error
 else SubstrateUnavailableException
  HTTP --> Caller : 503 substrate_unavailable
 else result
  HTTP --> Caller : op.result + rows + truncated_at
 end
end
note over Client
Six operation names are writable; catalog membership alone
does not authorize mutation. SQL operation bodies are separate.
end note

title: Modular Engine — shared read snapshot
body:
participant "Read handler" as Caller
participant "db_read / main.c" as Read
database "Primary connection" as Primary
participant "pool_open / read.c" as Pool
database "Pooled connections" as Workers
Caller -> Read : db_read(conninfo)
Read -> Primary : connect
Read -> Primary : BEGIN REPEATABLE READ, READ ONLY
alt begin fails
 Read --> Caller : exit(1), process terminates
else begin succeeds
 Read -> Primary : SELECT pg_export_snapshot()
 alt export fails or no row
  Read --> Caller : exit(1), process terminates
 else export succeeds
  Read -> Read : retain snapshot ID in process-static buffer
  Read --> Caller : primary connection with transaction open
  Caller -> Pool : a read requires pooled leaf queries
  alt pool already exists
   Pool --> Caller : reuse pool; no new import
  else pool not open
   Pool -> Workers : open max(1, omp_get_max_threads()) connections
   alt snapshot ID exists
    loop every pool connection
     Pool -> Workers : BEGIN REPEATABLE READ, READ ONLY
     Pool -> Workers : SET TRANSACTION SNAPSHOT retained ID
     alt import fails
      Pool --> Caller : exit(1), process terminates
     end
    end
   else no snapshot ID
    note over Pool,Workers : No snapshot import in this branch.
   end
  end
 end
end
note over Caller,Workers
Observed in source: pull, hop, translate, degrees, fills, turn and pgn call db_read.
Scope is this primary transaction and pools importing its snapshot.
Persistent replay evidence is a separate question.
end note

actor Caller
participant TurnWitness as W
queue "Bounded channel / 4096" as Q
participant "Single-reader service" as S
participant TurnCloser as C
alt RecordResponseAsync with empty reply
 W --> Caller : completed task; no enqueue or write
else nonempty response / prompt / complete turn
 Caller -> W : RecordTurnAsync

 W -> Q : WriteAsync(item, caller cancellation)

 Cancellation after enqueue stops the caller's wait.
 It does not remove the queued item.
 end note
 S -> Q : ReadAllAsync(service cancellation)
 Q --> S : next item
 S -> C : CloseAsync(item, service cancellation)
 C --> S : deposited boolean / exception
 S -> W : finally complete item's promise with deposited

  W --> Caller : success
 else deposited false and caller still waiting
  W --> Caller : SubstrateUnavailableException
 end
end

 Codepoint cache failure leaves service offline.
 Shutdown sets offline, completes channel, fails queued promises.
 TryEnqueueTurn is a separate nonwaiting API: false when full;
